records.description: Munich's 'City Klappen' directory entry isn't one location at all. It's a collection of older public-toilet meeting points at different U-Bahn and railway stations, with mentions of Odeonsplatz and Karl-Preis-Platz among others. A January 2026 commenter described an encounter at Odeonsplatz, while other messages referred to reopening work elsewhere or suggested entirely different parks. It would be misleading to use the one positive report as evidence that every station listed is active. Nor is there one address, entrance or visiting time that could sensibly describe all of them. The individual public facilities have separate management, opening hours and access restrictions. This record should be split into precise stations, checked individually and compared with existing Backroom entries before any location is published.
blockers: Aggregate of multiple distinct stations and toilets
One station's encounter cannot validate all others
records.tags: Multiple Locations, Public Restrooms, Requires Split
records.opening_notes: Each station facility has separate opening and access rules.

records.description: Stuttgart's Fernsehturm stands above the city among woodland paths, and older gay cruising guides identify its public toilet and adjacent wooded area as informal meeting points. The tower itself is a tourist attraction, so the relevant references concern the nearby public WC and paths, not a private venue inside the tower. An April 2026 visitor reported a firsthand encounter at the toilet, while someone checking in May found nobody. Earlier forum posts suggested evening visits, but these are not a dependable modern timetable; clearance of trees was also reported, potentially reducing privacy. The crowd could vary enormously with the weather and tower visitors, and there's no trustworthy numerical age range. Use only public paths and facilities, respect other visitors and understand that any sexual activity is subject to normal public-space rules.
records.tags: Woodland, Tourist Attraction, Public Restroom, Recent Report
records.opening_notes: Older reports mention evenings; April 2026 positive and May 2026 negative visits show attendance varies.
caveats: Specific restroom and woodland access subject to tower/public facility management

records.description: Madrid's Parque del Buen Retiro is famous for its sculptures, avenues and the Ángel Caído monument. Independent gay guides have long identified more sheltered paths and planted areas around that sector as historic cruising territory, and a 2024 El País report documented its reputation. More recent June 2026 messages on the directory mostly consist of people asking whether anyone wants to meet, not eyewitness accounts of encounters. The park is gated and its official winter closing time is 22:00, so old guide suggestions of midnight activity cannot simply be carried over. It remains a heavily used public attraction with ordinary walkers, tourists and families. Until recent visitors identify active paths and a dependable time within legitimate opening hours, describing it as a currently reliable spot would overstate the evidence.
blockers: Newer 2026 posts are invitations, not visit reports
Historic night-time claims contradict winter closure
Specific active paths and demographic profile not recently confirmed
records.address: Parque del Buen Retiro, Ángel Caído sector, Madrid
records.tags: Historic Park, City Centre, Heritage, Unverified Recent Activity
records.opening_notes: Official park winter closing approximately 22:00; do not treat old midnight suggestions as access permission.

records.description: Castellarnau is a wooded residential-edge area near Sabadell, north-west of Barcelona, and historic accounts identify pine woodland around the neighbourhood as an outdoor cruising meeting place. More than one gay directory mentions the forest, and local newspaper reports from 2019 and 2022 recorded neighbours' complaints and police involvement, including parking restrictions. In August and September 2026 people were posting proposed meetings on Cruisingmap, but those are not the same as eyewitness reports of completed visits or activity. Forestry access and vehicle restrictions may also have changed. The area is near homes, roads and other users of the paths, so old accounts of privacy and unrestricted parking cannot be assumed to hold. Before publication it needs a precise accessible subarea, a recent firsthand observation and an updated assessment of access restrictions.
blockers: Recent posts are meeting plans rather than witnessed encounters
No precise currently confirmed cruising trail or best period
records.tags: Pine Forest, Residential Edge, Parking Restrictions, Historical Reports
records.opening_notes: Outdoor access subject to municipal and forestry rules; no verified active peak time.

records.description: Plaza de Armas is the main bus station close to Seville's river and old town, and two independent cruising directories have identified its public toilets in the main building. The station is in regular use by travellers and transport staff, but the cruising reports readily available in the research archive run only through early and mid-2025, before this project's current twelve-month cutoff. No newer visitor account establishes where men actually gather, which facilities remain accessible or when they might be present. A bus fire in October 2026 prompted works around part of the platforms, but does not by itself establish that the toilets closed. Follow the operator's opening hours and don't assume the old stall descriptions remain valid. For Backroom this is an historical lead, not a confirmed current cruising venue.
blockers: No dated firsthand cruising reports after 2025 cutoff
Public toilet access and layout not recently verified
Building works may affect parts of station
records.address: Estación de Autobuses Plaza de Armas, Seville
records.tags: Bus Station, Public Restroom, Historic Reports
records.opening_notes: Station hours vary by day; check operator, not the historical cruise timetable.
